answer: Cosignatures are collected in echo, verified in vertex, and nectar names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 37 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, so that paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 111 dollars and 19 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
